items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: No, E. T. Thomas, they called him that. It was his band. But we went over there, you know. And so we went there, we stayed four months.

ctx.x: Well, which was the Black Eagle? I'm trying to get that straight. Is that E. Van Thomas' Black Eagle or was that your ...?

No, E. T. Thomas, they called him that. It was his band. But we went over there, you know. And so we went there, we stayed four months. I think we were headquartered and left here. Put up four months over there, so.
